details.title: Router: say "after one retry" in the 429 fallback reason
details.body:
## Say "after one retry" in the 429 fallback reason

**Problem.** The 429/5xx fallback reason says "failed twice", which reads as two different attempts. It is one call and one retry.

**Change.** The reason now says "failed after one retry". One line in `src/runtime/router.ts`; behaviour is unchanged.

**Check.** `pnpm eval --only router-fallback-429` failed before (`route_reason_contains "after one retry"`) and passes with this patch.
